text: The report is complete. A police message has already been sent to Bristol. At the Lantern, Maggie has begun a personal letter to Nora’s sister.
direction: A restrained British narrator for an intimate historical drama. Mature clear English voice, unhurried and humane, no trailer delivery. Even rounded baritone, fluid connected phrasing and gentle sentence endings. Observe events without sounding like a policeman giving evidence.
